description:
[read-only] The brand's lead response rule for click-to-message ads: whether a person who types to the ad gets an automatic first reply in the same Messenger/Instagram DM thread (off by default), its text ({{name}} = first name; null = the greeting), the platform window in hours, and up to 20 recent leads with when they were answered. No message text. Read-only.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/lead-replies.)

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands, or `personal`. Omitted: the key's brand (a brand-bound key) or the owner's active brand.

name: ads_lead_replies_get
title: Read the lead response rule
